{{Top|leg}}
'''Besia Osurne''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the ice [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedesia]]. It had a population of 250,000. Residents often wore fur caps as protection against the harsh cold. [[Trail's End]] tavern was situated near the stockyards within the city. [[Elodd Fask]] operated a ranch thirty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] west of Besia Osurne during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
